title: A Tide for the Vow
author: Noor Zhou
blurb: Rosalind Dunmore, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
